subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Should OpenClaw keep this four-layer collaboration stack as a core roadmap umbrella, narrow it to the Agent Teleconference/current subagent roadmap, or route most of it to plugin/ClawHub experimentation first?
rationale: The request spans routing policy, shared memory, security boundaries, persisted metrics, and budget enforcement, and VISION.md both supports better agent harness capabilities and warns against heavy orchestration layers in core for now.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella RFC
options.body: Leave this issue open as the high-level design tracker while requiring smaller product/security-reviewed issues for each accepted layer.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Primitives
options.body: Make the open Agent Teleconference and current subagent/session primitives the canonical path and close or supersede only after maintainers confirm that scope.

options.title: Prototype Outside Core First
options.body: Ask contributors to prove capability profiling, blackboard, and memory-boundary ideas through plugins or ClawHub packages unless a missing core seam is identified.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella RFC
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the high-level design tracker while requiring smaller product/security-reviewed issues for each accepted layer.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history and product-scope evidence make steipete the best available owner for deciding whether this broad architecture fits core now.
